item.title: Letters to The Province: Permanent standard time healthier for the body’s internal clock
item.description: Re: B.C. makes daylight time permanent after years of promises I see this is a thing again, and for some reason it’s always permanent daylight savings time. I have read that is not our circadian rhythm’s natural time, but no one seems to have even thought of splitting the difference or staying on standard time. […]

item.title: Canadian women miss playoff round at Vancouver rugby sevens
item.description: Coming into the tournament ranked fifth in the eight-team standings of the rugby circuit with 48 points, Canada dropped its opening game of pool play to the third-ranked United States (54 points) by a score of 40-7.
